name: Codex hook trailing-entity normalization
goal: Stop Codex Desktop's trailing   from breaking the state-activator.sh deactivate and commit/push hook-command gates, closing the Codex deadlock.

tasks.name: Normalize TRIMMED_PROMPT against trailing HTML space-entities (TDD)
tasks.description: Fix the Codex   deadlock at one choke point. Add four falsifiable hook tests, then normalize TRIMMED_PROMPT (state-activator.sh:46) so an end-anchored run of enumerated HTML space-entities is stripped after the whitespace trim. Every codex command gate reads TRIMMED_PROMPT, so this fixes deactivate + commit/push without touching any gate regex or the intent machinery, and cannot widen the guard. macOS uses BSD sed: the strip MUST be a single s/(...)+$// substitution, no :a..ta label/branch. The :138 slash grep reads raw USER_PROMPT (Claude path) and is left unchanged.

steps.description: RED. In worker/hooks/tests/test-professional-mode-deactivation.sh add a run_prompt_intent helper (run_prompt variant adding hook_event_name:"UserPromptSubmit" so the HUMAN_OPERATION block at state-activator.sh:53 is reachable), then append four assertions after line 108: (a) assert_deactivates on the codex deactivate Markdown link with a trailing  ; (b) assert_ignored on the same link with a ' now ' suffix; (c) reset_current then op_pos_output=$(run_prompt_intent '<codex commit-and-push link> ') and assert_contains "Human intent issuance runtime is unavailable" (state-activator.sh:112, reachable only inside 'if [ -n "$HUMAN_OPERATION" ]' at :74); (d) reset_current then op_neg_output on the same commit-and-push link with a ' now ' suffix and assert_not_contains that same string. Exact code in the human plan Task 1 Step 1.
steps.expected: Run ends non-zero (RED): case (a) fails (state stays on|brainstorming because the   breaks the :145 link regex) and case (c) fails (missing the runtime-unavailable string because the   breaks the :65 CODEX_COMMAND_LINK_RE so HUMAN_OPERATION never sets). Cases (b) and (d) already pass (non-widening controls that must hold before and after). Proves each new positive check can fail.

steps.description: GREEN. In worker/hooks/state-activator.sh replace line 46 `TRIMMED_PROMPT=$(printf '%s' "$USER_PROMPT" | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]+//; s/[[:space:]]+$//')` with `TRIMMED_PROMPT=$(printf '%s' "$USER_PROMPT" | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]+//; s/[[:space:]]+$//; s/( | | | | | |[[:space:]])+$//')`. One sed -E, three s commands; the third strips an end-anchored run of the enumerated space-entities plus interleaved whitespace. No :a..ta label/branch (BSD/macOS-sed safe). Only a TRAILING run is removed.
steps.expected: state-activator.sh:46 now has the third s-command stripping the trailing entity run; no other line changed.

steps.description: GREEN verify. Run the full hook suite.
steps.expected: Prints 'Results: N pass, 0 fail' and exits 0. All four new cases pass and every pre-existing case (lines 88-118) still passes. Do not stage while any case is RED.

steps.description: Stage both files (professional mode blocks commit; the human commits). Do NOT stage anything else; plan docs stay unstaged until after the next step's check.

No-regression evidence bounded to the two bash files. With only those two staged, run the UNFILTERED staged diff (no pathspec, so a stray third staged file appears and fails the check - falsifiable, matches requirements R4). This is the no-regression proof for the TS state-manager/workspace-manager and Python commander suites, none of which import or exercise this bash hook.
steps.expected: Exactly the two lines worker/hooks/state-activator.sh and worker/hooks/tests/test-professional-mode-deactivation.sh and nothing else staged; no TS/py source staged, so those suites cannot regress from this change.
